digest.component_or_area: LLM request headers and run identity delivery
propositions: Request headers resolved from ${run:...} references must be delivered via pydantic-ai ModelSettings.extra_headers to enable gateway attribution and grouping of gate calls
Header values must be redacted from durable records (verdicts, sidecars) and logs while header names are recorded in provider_provenance
The configuration dict must never be mutated across calls; a fresh dict must be passed per call to avoid polluting the config and leaking upstream version strings
Headers attach only when base_url is configured; absent ${run:...} substitutes are omitted entirely rather than sent empty to avoid breaking standalone operations
Header name-value pairs must be re-validated after ${run:...} substitution to close the validate-before-substitute gap
runner.py must remain at or under 800 lines by condensing comment blocks rather than extracting logic
